discoverSharmWasBuiltForOne: Discover Sharm was built for one simple reason: booking a trip to the Red Sea should feel as easy and trustworthy as the destination itself deserves. We're a Sharm El-Sheikh–based team that lives and works in this city, and we put together the hotels, excursions, transfers and restaurants we'd actually recommend to a friend.
weHandpickAndVetEveryExcursion: We handpick and vet every excursion operator, hotel partner, transfer provider and restaurant listed on our platform. Every booking made through Discover Sharm is backed by real local support — before, during and after your trip.
everyListingIsVettedByOur: Every listing is vetted by our local team before it goes live.

cancellationTermsCanVarySlightlyBy: Cancellation terms can vary slightly by individual hotel, excursion or transfer listing — always check the specific policy shown on the booking page before you pay. Unless a listing states otherwise, the following standard terms apply:
cancellationsMadeMoreThan48Hours: Cancellations made more than 48 hours before the scheduled check-in, departure, or pickup time are eligible for a full refund.
cancellationsMadeBetween2448Hours: Cancellations made between 24–48 hours before are eligible for a 50% refund.
cancellationsMadeLessThan24Hours: Cancellations made less than 24 hours before, or no-shows, are non-refundable.
youCanRequestACancellationFrom: You can request a cancellation from the "My Bookings" section of your account, or by contacting our support team directly with your booking reference.
inCasesOfSevereWeatherSafety: In cases of severe weather, safety closures, or other circumstances outside our control, we'll work with you on rebooking or a full refund regardless of the standard window above.
refundsAreIssuedAccordingToThe: Refunds are issued according to the cancellation terms of your specific booking (see our Cancellation Policy), or in the event a listing is unable to fulfil a confirmed booking.
approvedRefundsAreProcessedBackTo: Approved refunds are processed back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days, depending on your bank or card issuer.
certainPromotionalOrDiscountedRatesMay: Certain promotional or discounted rates may be marked as non-refundable at the time of booking — this will always be clearly stated before you complete payment.
contactOurSupportTeamWithYour: Contact our support team with your booking reference and we'll look into it personally.
byUsingDiscoverSharmToBrowse: By using Discover Sharm to browse, book or manage hotels, excursions, transfers or restaurant reservations, you agree to these Terms of Service.
discoverSharmActsAsABooking: Discover Sharm acts as a booking platform connecting you with independent hotels, excursion operators, transfer companies and restaurants. Each listing is responsible for delivering the service you book; we're here to make finding and booking it easy, and to support you if something goes wrong.
pricesAreShownInEgyptianPounds: Prices are shown in Egyptian Pounds (EGP) and include applicable taxes and fees unless stated otherwise. Payment is processed securely at checkout via our payment partner.
youreResponsibleForKeepingYourAccount: You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure and for the accuracy of the information you provide when booking.
seeOurCancellationPolicyAndRefund: See our Cancellation Policy and Refund Policy for details.
discoverSharmIsNotLiableFor: Discover Sharm is not liable for the acts or omissions of independent hotels, excursion operators, transfer companies or restaurants listed on the platform, beyond facilitating the booking and supporting resolution of issues in good faith.
weMayUpdateTheseTermsFrom: We may update these terms from time to time; continued use of the platform after changes means you accept the updated terms.
whenYouCreateAnAccountOr: When you create an account or make a booking, we collect your name, email, phone number, and booking details. We use secure third-party providers to process payments and never store full card numbers ourselves.
weUseYourInformationToProcess: We use your information to process bookings, communicate with you about your trip, provide support, and — with your consent — send you occasional offers relevant to Sharm El-Sheikh travel.
weShareOnlyTheBookingDetails: We share only the booking details necessary (name, contact info, dates) with the specific hotel, excursion operator, transfer company or restaurant you book with, so they can fulfil your reservation.
weUseIndustryStandardSecurityPractices: We use industry-standard security practices to protect your data, including encrypted connections and secure authentication.
youCanReviewUpdateOrRequest: You can review, update or request deletion of your personal data at any time from your account settings, or by contacting our support team.
